title: Representation theory
summary: A connected family of roadmaps for the representation theory of groups, algebras, and Lie algebras, downstream of Mathlib. Each subdirectory is a self-contained roadmap (a definitive README.md plus a Suggested.lean of target signatures); this page is the index and the map of how they fit together. The organizing principle is the one stated across the roadmaps: build the general theory, and specialize only where a special case genuinely unlocks the general construction. The module and algebra core is primary and Mathlib-native; the analytic and categorical layers are introduced where they generalize.
